name: [A2] Sync ERP estado_lead → Vtiger leadstatus
description: ADR-0036: cierra bidireccional ERP↔Vtiger. Cron 2min consulta /api/internal/leads/pending-vtiger-sync con cursor (audit_log.id). Para cada item: auth Vtiger + update leadstatus + emit audit event vtiger.leadstatus_synced. Cursor avanza al max audit_log_id procesado.
